## 2B.7 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Bottom line:** The 2024 record is strongly favorable on ceasefires, peace talks, and confidence-building. Lula repeatedly chose negotiation-first pathways on Ukraine and Gaza, and Brazil joined a Gaza declaration that explicitly demanded a ceasefire, hostage release, and humanitarian aid. I found only mild counterevidence: Ukraine criticized the Brazil-China peace initiative as exclusionary, and Lula’s Gaza rhetoric was confrontational, but the policy line still favored peace processes.

### Accepted claims

- **Claim:** Lula publicly framed Ukraine and Gaza as problems for peace talks, not force.
  - **Title:** [Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken, and Planalto separately reiterated his desire for peace and an end to the conflicts, including support for a Palestinian state. This is direct ceasefire-and-talks evidence.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`; also `2B.1`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Brazil and China’s Ukraine proposal centered on dialogue, direct talks, and a comprehensive ceasefire.
  - **Title:** [Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** May 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The joint statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for conditions to resume direct talks and move toward a comprehensive ceasefire. That is strong evidence of a lawful settlement effort.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`; also `2B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula used the UN General Assembly to push dialogue and de-escalation.
  - **Title:** [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 24, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula warned that nuclear arsenals and destructive weapons were driving confrontation and said direct dialogue was crucial. This reinforces that he was seeking de-escalatory off-ramps when they existed.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula’s Summit of the Future speech rejected a return to nuclear threats and supported multilateral off-ramps.
  - **Title:** [President Lula's speech at the Summit of the Future opening in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said the world could not go back to living with nuclear threats and linked that warning to arms-race criticism and multilateral reform. This is consistent with credible peace-process orientation.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Brazil joined a Gaza declaration that explicitly called for ceasefire, hostage release, and aid access.
  - **Title:** [Brasil assina declaração conjunta pelo fim dos ataques sobre Gaza](https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza)
  - **Publisher:** Agência Gov / MRE
  - **Date:** June 6, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza
  - **Claim-level summary:** The declaration demanded that hostilities stop, hostages be released immediately and unconditionally, and humanitarian aid reach civilians. This is direct evidence of ceasefire support and confidence-building on a live war.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`; also `2B.4`, `2B.5`

### Counterevidence / caveats

- **Claim:** Ukraine criticized the Brazil-China peace initiative as exclusionary and “destructive.”
  - **Title:** [Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** September 12, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966
  - **Claim-level summary:** Zelenskiy said Kyiv was not included and argued the plan lacked respect for Ukraine’s territorial integrity. This weakens the credibility of the proposal, but it still points to mediation rather than war prolongation.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`; also `1B.4`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula’s Gaza rhetoric was harsh and triggered diplomatic rupture, though the policy direction remained ceasefire-oriented.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The rhetoric increased tension with Israel, but it did not displace the documented ceasefire, hostage-release, and humanitarian-aid positions.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.7`; also `1B.2`, `1B.8`

### Search gap

I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence of:
- post-conflict reconciliation programs,
- formal confidence-building measures beyond the ceasefire and talks language,
- or a negotiated settlement that was actually implemented.

So the evidence base is strongest on **attempted peace processes and ceasefires**, not on completed settlements or reconciliation outcomes.
